summary.text: You can use MediSave up to $1,130 daily for the first two days and $400 daily after. Surgery limits depend on surgery complexity.

details.heading: Daily hospital charges
details.body: You can use up to $1,130 per day from MediSave for the first two days of inpatient stays, and $400 per day thereafter.

details.heading: Surgery costs
details.body: The amount you can use depends on the complexity of your surgery.

details.heading: Hospital stay rule
details.body: You are considered hospitalised if you have been admitted for at least eight hours. This requirement does not apply to day surgeries.

example_phrasings: If I am hospitalised, how much MediSave can I use to pay for my hospitalisation expenses?
How much MediSave can I use for my hospital stay?
What is the MediSave limit for hospitalisation?

sources.page_title: If I am hospitalised, how much MediSave can I use to pay for my hospitalisation expenses?

quotes.text: For daily hospital charges1, you can use up to $1,130 per day from MediSave for the first two days of inpatient stays, and $400 per day thereafter.
The amount of MediSave you can use depends on the complexity of your surgery, as listed in the Table of Surgical Procedures.
It is useful to note that you are considered hospitalised if you have been admitted for at least eight hours. This requirement does not apply to day surgeries.
